description: This is a test module for the /auth/register endpoint in a FastAPI application. It contains integration tests that verify various scenarios such as password length validation, handling of duplicate emails, and the use of an in-memory SQLite database for testing. The code defines setup functions for environment configuration, a test client, and multiple test cases to ensure the registration endpoint behaves correctly under different conditions.

methods.name: using_inmemory_db()
methods.description: Context manager to set up a temporary in-memory SQLite database for testing, ensuring proper setup and cleanup of environment variables and database tables.

methods.name: _client()
methods.description: Returns a FastAPI TestClient instance for testing the application, ensuring startup/shutdown routines are properly executed.

methods.name: str _password_of_bytes(n: int)
methods.description: Generates a string of 'a' characters of length n, used to simulate passwords of specific byte lengths.

methods.name: test_register_with_valid_password_returns_201()
methods.description: Tests that a valid registration request with a proper password returns a 201 Created status and correct user data.

methods.name: test_register_with_7_chars_returns_400()
methods.description: Tests that a registration attempt with a password shorter than 8 characters returns a 400 error with an appropriate message.

methods.name: test_register_with_1000_chars_returns_201()
methods.description: Tests that a very long password (1000 characters) is accepted and results in a 201 status.

methods.name: test_register_duplicate_email_returns_409()
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to register with an email already in use returns a 409 Conflict error.
